title: A Multiscale Finite Element Method for reaction-diffusion eigenproblems arising from neutronics
summary: We consider reaction-diffusion eigenproblems with oscillatory diffusion and reaction coefficients. The reaction coefficient magnitude is large: the corrector equation identified by periodic homogenization involves both the diffusion and the reaction operators. We study the numerical approximation of this problem using the Multiscale Finite Element Method (MsFEM). This now classical method is a finite element type method that performs a Galerkin approximation of the oscillatory problem on a specific, problem dependent, basis set. The basis functions are precomputed in an offline stage.…
